findings.coordinator_is_CPU_busy: Both coordinators grow to about101.7% sampled process CPU in the last30s; not evidence for pure IO wait. Process CPU includes its threads.
findings.explicit_physical_work: Three explicit per-command scopes total about15.1s per90s. The remaining about74.8s is not instrumented by these scopes and is not assigned to a single function.
findings.control_gradient_stable: Full task/view gradient medians stay about61ms across all thirds; capture/reanchor remains about6–13ms.
findings.history_growth: Control snapshot serialization and JSON writing grow, and the history-bearing stiffness subtree grows to1.48/1.56MB. Existing recursive-freeze auxiliary proxy costs20/22ms late, insufficient by itself to explain the1.3–1.4s coordinator gaps.
findings.K_is_separately_backlogged: Keep evidence rises to1.68/2.53s median in last30s while representative selection is0.113/0.123s; K worker is near100% CPU. Body update adoption does not wait for K.
findings.unresolved: No direct scopes around coordinator Queue.get/unpickle, message freezing/adoption, manifest/statistics, acquisition spooling, lock hold or garbage collection. Their shares cannot be established from these recordings.
